mapper.select: SELECT id, subject_code AS subjectCode, title, chapter_number AS chapterNumber, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM k_chapter WHERE subject_code = #{subjectCode} AND id LIKE 'course_%' ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT id, chapter_id AS chapterId, title, summary, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM k_section WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT c.subject_code AS subjectCode, c.title AS chapterTitle, c.chapter_number AS chapterOrder, c.id AS chapterId, p.id AS pointId, p.title AS pointTitle, p.importance AS importance, p.exam_frequency AS examFrequency, p.tags_json AS tagsJson FROM k_chapter c JOIN k_section s ON s.chapter_id = c.id JOIN k_point p ON p.section_id = s.id ORDER BY c.subject_code, c.chapter_number, s.sort_order, p.sort_order

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.summary, p.importance, p.exam_frequency AS examFrequency, p.tags_json AS tagsJson, c.subject_code AS subjectCode, c.title AS chapterTitle, a.content_md AS contentMd, a.meta_json AS metaJson FROM k_point p JOIN k_section s ON s.id = p.section_id JOIN k_chapter c ON c.id = s.chapter_id LEFT JOIN k_article a ON a.point_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{pointId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.section_id AS sectionId, p.title, p.summary, p.importance, p.exam_frequency AS examFrequency, p.tags_json AS tagsJson, a.content_md AS contentMd, a.meta_json AS metaJson FROM k_point p LEFT JOIN k_article a ON a.point_id = p.id WHERE p.section_id = #{sectionId} ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1
